outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/table (breast anatomy drawing and classification table), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the study aim, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental setup for luciferase recordings, not a data plot.
Panel D is a schematic with idealized example traces illustrating the analysis workflow, not real averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel E shows an illustrative heatmap representing the concept of correlation analysis, not actual averaged data; heatmaps in general also do not require individual points.
Panel F is a schematic with an idealized line plot illustrating growth quantification concept, not real averaged experimental data.
Panel G is a schematic with an idealized dose-response curve illustrating the workflow concept, not real averaged experimental data.
Panel H is a schematic with illustrative heatmap/matrix graphics representing the genomic analysis concept, not real averaged data.

Panel I is a schematic containing illustrative scatter plots (PCA cluster and 3D parameter space) used as conceptual examples for the graphical abstract; scatter plots inherently show individual points and are exempt from this check.
